description: Puts an X call on the authenticated user's X Calls calendar, with them as its organizer, and invites people to it. The call exists right away: share its join_url, or put an agent in it at start time with POST /2/calls/:id/join. A recurrence (an RFC 5545 RRULE) repeats it. Invitees get an email unless notify_invitees is false.

duration_minutes.description: How long the call lasts, in minutes. Defaults to 30; at most 31 days.

invitee_ids.description: X user ids of the people to invite.

notify_invitees.description: Whether invitees get an email about the call. Defaults to true.

recurrence.description: RFC 5545 RRULE to repeat the call by, such as FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO; the RRULE: prefix is optional.

start_time.description: When the call starts (RFC 3339); not in the past.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone the recurrence follows, such as America/Los_Angeles.
